rule: Every capability is bound to an E0-E5 evidence level, the tree/SHA, environment, and (where applicable) run/artifact/reviewer. No static file, test count, or declaration may impersonate runtime evidence. E1 = structural validation passes (files/schema/tests). E2 = isolated runtime. E3 = real runtime use. E4 = frozen + independent review. E5 = external validation. Evidence files live in .hermes/task-runtime/ (gitignored) and reports/.

E1.label: structural
E1.proof: hash, parser, schema or linter output

E3.label: runtime
E3.proof: runtime id + task id + artifact provenance

E4.label: frozen
E4.proof: frozen tree + independent review + exact-SHA CI
